claim_checked: (A) premise limits reach other cluster members
what_is_wrong_or_confirmed: Edge-keyed premises (premise_unresolved/refuted) are applied only to members of the SAME (question, hypothesis, main_target) cluster (run_generation_it21.py cmd_propose: cl_dec keyed by that triple). Rows in other clusters whose chain contains the premised edge get nothing. Handed-over IT21P2-0217 razuprotafib (Q5 H_HARM, PTPRB) has the chain MAPK1 -P(+)-> BCL3 -T(-)-> TNF that tizaterkib's INCONCLUSIVE record (edge:BCL3>TNF, direct ERK->TNF route opposes) is about; its carried_limits is empty. Same for eligible Begacestat/Avagacestat (PSEN1) and Rivoceranib (edge:NOTCH1>MYC), 36 of 42 chain-matching rows carry no limit (verifier recompute, findings_support/premise_reach).
suggested_correction: Apply scope premises to every row whose chain matches the edge (any cluster), as a carried limit; re-emit the hand-over for 0217/0218 with the BCL3>TNF limit.

what_is_wrong_or_confirmed: E-02 decisive datum (a) is 'the compound acts on the seed genes through HIF stabilisation, not through the proposed EGLN2 -> FOXO3 chain' (qualification_it9_p4c_e_20261030/records/E-02_roxadustat.md:7). That is a property of the prolyl-hydroxylase class, not of the molecule. The scope table tags E-02 only as molecule (label) + premise_refuted FOXO3>SLC2A1, so the hand-over of desidustat (IT21P2-0043; chain EGLN2 -> FOXO3 -> BNIP3) carries only SECOND_SYSTEM_GATE_FAILED; roxadustat appears in alternatives_same_mechanism without its DROP. Desidustat also has no GtoPdb affinity (NOT_ASSESSABLE) and no EGLN isoform datum.
suggested_correction: Add scope premise_unresolved 'target:EGLN2 chain mismatch (HIF stabilisation is the direct route)' for E-02 and carry it to all PHD-inhibitor rows; list roxadustat as 'DROP in IT9' in alternatives.

what_is_wrong_or_confirmed: All 24 rows are Q4 H_HARM with the identical chain BTK -P(-)-> STAT3 -> NPY and seed S116, so the label applies to each (none should be released on chain/seed grounds). But the premise is not 'refuted': the source text itself says 'measured low, not a proof of absence' (decision_scope_it22.tsv CGI-1746 row); BTK is 0.07-0.50 cpm in organoid KO and WT, and NPY itself is 0.05-0.12 cpm KO v 3.2-7.7 WT, i.e. a rare-cell transcript, so a pseudobulk BTK of that order cannot exclude BTK in the NPY-producing cell; the BTK->STAT3 edges are B-cell/review. This is a judgement veto labelled as a refutation; reclassified as premise_unresolved it would carry a limit and let a BTK row compete in Q4 H_HARM.
suggested_correction: Relabel as premise_contested (carried limit, demoted) or keep the veto but state it as a judgement; do not call it refuted.

what_is_wrong_or_confirmed: _pair_state treats a censored value on the OTHER target as not comparable. A '<' on the best target can only make the main-target fold larger. IT21P2-0616 londamocitinib: JAK2 IC50 1,220 nM exact vs JAK1 IC50 '<3 nM' (raw ligand 11716): fold >= 407 and main > 1,000 nM, so WEAK_ATTRIBUTION; the table says NOT_COMPARABLE_MEASURES and the row stays eligible (it was WEAK-blocked in IT21). Also AZD-1480 JAK2 and others skip a censored pair silently while the verdict takes the minimum over the remaining pairs.
suggested_correction: Accept (main '=' or '>') vs (best '<') as lower_bound; add a test.

what_is_wrong_or_confirmed: The fallback is skipped for an EMPTY original type: `typ = r.get('Original Affinity Units') or '?'` turns '' into '?' before the test `typ in ('-','')`. In the raw file 2,491 human rows (pKi 1,686; pIC50 389; pKd 251; pEC50 165) have an empty original type and a usable p-value; they are typed '?' instead of Ki/IC50/Kd/EC50 (the '-' case, 2,682 rows, works). Visible effect on the committed table: IT21P2-0194 clotrimazole (NOT_COMPARABLE, should be ATTRIBUTABLE) and IT21P2-0402 tretinoin (RORB pKi/pIC50 stay '?'; state changes under the verifier's typing); dexamethasone NR3C2 typed '?'. The producer README claims the fallback works.
suggested_correction: Test for empty and '-' separately; rerun.

what_is_wrong_or_confirmed: Hand-over 0005 reports ATTRIBUTABLE, HDAC5 47 nM v HDAC10 40 nM, with no mention that the package's own batch1 record and the correction note (point 3) state a 109-fold disagreement (ChEMBL IC50 5,113 nM) and call attribution undecidable. what_is_wrong_or_confirmed: No row lies between 803 nM (abrocitinib) and 3,160 nM (GSK2334470), so the boundary at 1,000 or 3,000 nM gives the same 6 WEAK rows; at 300 nM it would be 13 (README sensitivity 13/6/6 reproduces). The 100-1000 nM SECONDARY band is policy: nanatinostat (66.7-fold, 200 nM) was REJECTED on exactly this ground while trichostatin A (1,300-fold), dacinostat, belinostat and givinostat are eligible for the same HDAC5 role.
suggested_correction: State the inconsistency in the README (policy, not data).

claim_checked: (B) 'verdict follows the type most favourable to the main target'

suggested_correction: Report the per-type table; never let a more potent main-target type hide a same-type deficit.
